description: Single source of truth for all projects in your zeos fleet. Each project boots with the live kernel — no version pinning. Add your own apps here as you onboard them via /newproject.

architecture.policy: Projects inherit kernel improvements instantly. Velocity over isolation.

schema_docs.name: Human-readable project name
schema_docs.local_path: Path relative to ~/projects/ where this repo lives locally
schema_docs.capabilities: Array of strings describing what this project does
schema_docs.modules: Array of zeos modules this project loads (e.g., 'team')
schema_docs._resolved_paths: SOUL, MEMORY, and journals are resolved centrally by the inject MCP server (path-resolver.ts). SOUL lives at ~/projects/zeos/souls/<app_id>/SOUL.md; MEMORY at ~/projects/zeos/memory/<app_id>/MEMORY.md; journals at ~/projects/zeos/journals/<app_id>/. Project CLAUDE.md lives at <local_path>/CLAUDE.md.
